name: VETO
source:
In a dying world, life goes on in the apartment of an evacuated city, under the ever-present threat of the mysterious RED PEOPLE.

[From [url=https://plainsightproyects.itch.io/veto]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在垂死的世界里，神秘“赤色之人”的威胁无处不在；而在一座已疏散清空的都市公寓内，生活仍在继续。

[摘自[url=https://plainsightproyects.itch.io/veto]itch.io[/url]]
